verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an LLM inference engine that ships a CLI, a server and a built-in web UI. A document workspace is a plausible axis for local-LLM tooling with a UI, so the story applies. The evidence only shows chat and inference, with nothing about an agent drafting or editing documents in an integrated workspace or saving changes automatically.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
